info.title: Shopping Research Assistant API
info.summary: Research products, track Canadian prices, get drop alerts. Never purchases anything.

get.summary: Is the API (and its database) up?
get.description: Always 200 while the API runs; `database` says whether PostgreSQL is reachable.

post.description: Returns a fresh thread ID. Nothing is stored until the first message is sent.

schema.title: Response List Threads Api V1 Threads Get

get.description: Messages, the latest comparison, the chosen product and any pending confirmation.

post.description: A new or existing thread ID. A pending confirmation is cancelled first (FR-4.4).

200.description: Server-Sent Events. Each message is `event: progress|result|error` plus `data: <JSON>`; see the `StreamEvent` schema. Any number of `progress` events, then one `result` or `error`.

404.description: The conversation belongs to someone else.

409.description: A turn is already running in this conversation.

404.description: No such conversation, or nothing pending.

post.description: `track` saves one watchlist item per selected listing; `cancel` saves nothing.

409.description: Nothing pending, or a turn is already running.

schema.title: Response List Items Api V1 Watchlist Get

patch.summary: Pause, resume or change the target

delete.summary: Delete an item and its price history
delete.description: Irreversible: the web app asks the user to confirm first.

post.summary: Start a price check of every active item
post.description: Returns at once with the new run (status 'running'). Alerts use the saved notification settings.

503.description: Alerts or the database aren't set up

schema.title: Response List Checks Api V1 Checks Get

get.summary: Running check, last check and next scheduled check

delete.summary: Forget my alert channel (use the .env settings)

post.summary: Send a test alert through my channel

comparison.description: Set on a message that presented a comparison; show it as cards instead of `text`.

listings.title: Listings
listings.description: Set on a message that presented retailer listings.

alerts_failed.title: Alerts Failed
alerts_failed.description: Not delivered; retried at the next check.

CheckRun.title: CheckRun
CheckRun.description: One price check of a user's active items (a `monitor_runs` row).

running.description: The check in progress, if any.

last_finished.description: The most recent check that ended.

target_price.title: Target Price
target_price.description: Omit to use the suggested target.

ConfirmTracking.title: ConfirmTracking
ConfirmTracking.description: Answer to a pending confirmation. Listing numbers are 1-based.

ErrorBody.description: Every error response (and the SSE `error` event) has this shape.

message.description: Plain-language explanation that can be shown to the user.
message.title: Message

details.description: Extra data, e.g. the invalid fields.
details.title: Details

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

FinalizedProduct.description: The product the user chose. Only `name` is guaranteed.
FinalizedProduct.title: FinalizedProduct

source.title: Source
source.description: 'env' = nothing saved yet; the .env values are in use.

webhook_url_hint.title: Webhook Url Hint
webhook_url_hint.description: Masked webhook URL, e.g. 'https://discord.com/…f3a9'. None if none is set.

email_available.title: Email Available
email_available.description: Whether the server can send email (sender and Resend/SMTP in .env).

NotificationSettingsOut.title: NotificationSettingsOut
NotificationSettingsOut.description: The alert channel in use. Secrets are never returned: the webhook URL is masked.

PendingConfirmation.description: Listings waiting for the user to choose what to track (FR-4).

listings.description: Numbered from 1 in this order when confirming.
listings.title: Listings

suggested_target.description: Default target: the discount below the cheapest listing.
suggested_target.title: Suggested Target

discount.description: The fraction used for the suggested target, e.g. 0.1.
discount.title: Discount

PendingConfirmation.title: PendingConfirmation

is_lowest.title: Is Lowest
is_lowest.description: The first check at the lowest in-stock price.

sources.description: URLs of the search results the comparison is based on.
sources.title: Sources

worker_running.title: Worker Running
worker_running.description: False if the worker is stopped or hasn't reported for 3 minutes.

next_run_at.title: Next Run At
next_run_at.description: When the next scheduled check is due.

ScheduleStatus.title: ScheduleStatus
ScheduleStatus.description: The background worker (`shopping-assistant worker`), as last reported.

thread_id.title: Thread Id
thread_id.description: Use this ID to send the first message; the thread is listed after that.

reply.description: All assistant text produced this turn.
reply.title: Reply

comparison.description: The latest comparison; option numbers refer to its candidates.

finalized_product.description: Set when a product was chosen in this turn.

UpdateNotificationSettings.title: UpdateNotificationSettings
UpdateNotificationSettings.description: Omit `webhook_url` or `alert_email` to keep the saved value; send null to clear it.

latest_price.title: Latest Price
latest_price.description: Price at the most recent check.

message.description: What the assistant is doing now, for display.
message.title: Message

StreamEvent.description:
One SSE message: `event: <event>` then `data: <JSON of data>`. A stream sends any number of
`progress` events, then exactly one `result` or `error`, then closes.
StreamEvent.title: StreamEvent
